name: Python
description: High-level programming language known for clean syntax, versatile standard library, and dominance in data science and backend engineering.

name: JavaScript
description: Core language of the web powering interactive frontends, server-side Node.js applications, and browser APIs.

name: TypeScript
description: Statically typed superset of JavaScript providing compile-time type safety, interfaces, and maintainable enterprise codebases.

name: Java
description: Object-oriented, statically typed platform language widely utilized in enterprise backends, Android systems, and financial architectures.

name: C++
description: High-performance systems programming language with manual memory control, pointers, templates, and low runtime overhead.

name: React
description: Declarative component-based UI library utilizing virtual DOM, hooks, state management, and vibrant ecosystem.

name: Node.js
description: Asynchronous event-driven JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine for building scalable server-side network applications.

name: Express
description: Fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js powering REST APIs and routing middleware.

name: Spring Boot
description: Enterprise microservice framework facilitating stand-alone, production-grade Spring applications with dependency injection.

name: FastAPI
description: Modern, fast web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints and OpenAPI schemas.

name: SQL & Relational Databases
description: Structured query language for schema design, indexing, transactions (ACID), joins, and relational querying in PostgreSQL/MySQL.

name: MongoDB
description: Document-oriented NoSQL database supporting dynamic JSON-like document models, aggregations, and horizontal sharding.

name: REST APIs
description: Representational State Transfer principles including HTTP verbs, status codes, payload formatting, idempotency, and contract design.

name: Docker
description: Platform for containerizing applications with standardized environments, Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and compose networks.

name: Kubernetes
description: Production-grade container orchestration system for automating application deployment, scaling, pods, services, and ingress.

name: Linux & Bash
description: UNIX-based operating system administration, permissions, shell scripting, process management, and terminal tooling.

name: Git & Version Control
description: Distributed version control system for tracking source code changes, branching strategies, merges, rebasing, and pull requests.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, sorting algorithms, and asymptotic complexity analysis.

name: Pandas & NumPy
description: Core scientific computing and data wrangling libraries for multi-dimensional arrays, dataframes, and transformations.

name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised and unsupervised algorithms (linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, clustering, gradient boosting).

name: Deep Learning
description: Neural networks, gradient descent backpropagation, convolutional networks, attention mechanisms, and PyTorch architectures.

name: Network Security & Cryptography
description: Packet inspection, SSL/TLS handshakes, asymmetric encryption, firewalls, threat models, and vulnerability scanning.

name: Figma & UI Prototyping
description: Interface design, interactive prototyping, component variants, auto-layout, typography systems, and design tokens.

name: Data Visualization & BI
description: Visual data communication using Power BI, Tableau, or Seaborn to create executive dashboards and cohort visualizations.

name: Product Strategy & Agile
description: User story mapping, sprint management, prioritization matrices (RICE), KPI definition, and product discovery.
